Data sourced from FMCSA's Motus Carrier and Company Census dataset (data.transportation.gov yu5v-wbh6) or the legacy AuthHist file (frozen 14 May 2026) when Motus has no history. Returns facts only, not verdicts. Public endpoint requiring no API key; cached one day per carrier with network and site-wide rate limits.
